bin_rules.range_bins: <54; 54-69; 70-180 (70 <= v <= 180); 181-250 (180 < v <= 250); >250 mg/dL. Note: preprocess.py bins put exactly 180 and 250 in the upper bin; here they go in the lower bin as the labels say.
bin_rules.within_k_k: within k mg/dL when the reference is below 100 mg/dL, else within k %
bin_rules.icgm_table: the rule's own criteria: mg/dL limits for CGM < 70, percent limits at or above 70, +-20 % for all pairs; binned by CGM value
bin_rules.run_in_vs_randomised: randomised phase = reference day >= participant's randomisation day (days since enrolment)
bin_rules.reference_source: Sets A, B, C use only rows read from the meter's own log (source = meter, Contour Next). Pump BG entries are excluded: in the CGM-only arm they are mostly CGM values typed into the pump bolus calculator (see pump_entry_check).

A.name: meter-log fingersticks not used for calibration, in window, CGM+BGM arm, randomised phase (headline)

B.name: meter-log fingersticks not used for calibration, in window, all participants and phases

C.name: meter-log fingersticks not used for calibration, in window, CGM-only arm, randomised phase (sensitivity)

D.name: calibration pairs, in window (sensor just before correction)

E.name: all meter-table pairs in window, every reference source, including calibration-timed ones (old headline set)

S.name: Shanghai fingerstick pairs (Abbott flash CGM), all patients with a fingerstick

funnel_E_to_A.step: E0: all meter-table pairs, all days (midterm headline)
E: keep the study window only (day 0-329)
Em: keep meter-log rows only (drop pump BG entries)
B: drop pairs used for calibration

reconciliation_with_results_md.note: Bins here put exactly 180 and 250 mg/dL in the lower range; RESULTS.md bins put them in the upper range. Differences are in the last digit at most.
